comment: Hand-chosen addresses (linked VA) and claims. `verify_target.py --regen-pins` decodes them and writes pins.json; the claim text is the author's reading, the bytes/asm are decoded from the ELF.
windows: empty output buffer (cap 0, ptr 1, len 0); pair pointer (incoming rsi) goes to the pair serializer in rdx
only result head 0x8000000000000004 continues to the hash; anything else takes the diagnostic path
state record: offset(+0xe8)=0 by zeroing, rate (+0xf0)=0x88, delimiter byte (+0xf8)=1, squeeze flag (+0xf9)=0
update(buffer ptr, len) via slot 0x64e0148; copy 0xe0-byte state; finalize 0x20 output bytes via slot 0x64e0150
the whole 32-byte digest is stored to the caller's result; no truncation in this function
writer record at rsp+0x40 holds the buffer pointer; its byte +0xb (rsp+0x4b) is 1
the pair is (TokenSpec pointer, index): r15 = first word, r14 = second word
compound state with sentinel 0x8000000000000000 (direct mode), writer pointer, count 2
TokenSpec is written first (0x3c453f0), then the index through the unsigned adapter (0x41d2670)
writer byte +0xb nonzero selects the map header with count 3 (0x3d4f6d0); zero would select the array header
key string `name` (length 4) written when byte +0xb is 1
name value: pointer [spec+8], length [spec+0x10], through the string writer
szDecimals read as the byte at spec+0x18; key string length 10
szDecimals value through the unsigned writer (zero-extended u8)
weiDecimals read as the byte at spec+0x19; key string length 11
weiDecimals value through the unsigned writer (zero-extended u8)
first word equal to i64::MIN (neg overflows) selects the direct path
direct path writes the index with the unsigned writer 0x3d517e0
result 2 maps to the success sentinel (adds 4 to 0x8000000000000000)
direct mode test in the compound finish
direct mode returns 0x8000000000000004 without writing bytes
values below 0x100 take the byte path
bit 7 set (128..255) goes to the 0xcc path
below 128 the value byte is stored as is (positive fixint)
128..255: marker byte 0xcc, then the value byte
16-bit helper 0x3d51d10 gets the value in esi
value >> 32 == 0 selects the 32-bit helper, else the 64-bit helper
32-bit helper 0x3d51f40 gets the value in esi
64-bit helper 0x3d520d0 gets the value in rsi
32-bit length below 0x100 continues in the 0xd9 path
payload bytes copied verbatim after the header
fixstr: low 5 bits of the length or'd into 0xa0
fixarray: low 4 bits of the count or'd into 0x90
fixmap: low 4 bits of the count or'd into 0x80
the index is the word at state+0x28
the rejection returns the 15-byte message `too many tokens`
pair = (pointer to the TokenSpec copy at rsp+0x10, index); digest function 0x38d2ce0
the first 16 bytes of the returned digest are kept as the id
id passed to the 16-byte-key entry function 0x3cd39b0
result tag 1 (occupied) takes the error path
the shared error tail stores length 0x17 (23) for that message
vacant: index (from [rsp+8]) goes to the insert function 0x3f19f10
first key qword compared byte-swapped (big-endian order)
delimiter byte ([+0xe0] of the copy) xor'd into the buffer at the offset
